digest.component_or_area: trusted gate service AWS infrastructure and deployment
propositions: Terraform must declare an API Gateway HTTP API v2 with SigV4 (AWS_IAM) authorization on all routes, integrating via HTTPS to the existing rebar-gerrit box origin with a static X-Opcert-Guard header injection.
An IAM role rebar-opcert-admin must be created with execute-api:Invoke permissions scoped only to the new API Gateway, restricted by principal ARNs supplied via opcert_admin_principal_arns variable.

Two SSM SecureString parameters must be created at /rebar/prod/opcert-ed25519-key (with lifecycle ignore_changes to preserve operator-seeded key) and /rebar/prod/opcert-origin-guard (fully Terraform-managed), both under the existing rebar-gerrit-ssm-params-read policy grant.

The nginx configuration must enforce a fail-closed guard: the /opcert/ location must check X-Opcert-Guard against a guard map sourced from SSM via materialize-opcert-guard.sh, rejecting requests without a matching header with HTTP 403.

The opcert compose service must be wired into compose-up.sh to run after materialize-opcert-guard.sh but before docker compose up, materializing the guard value from SSM and reloading host nginx to activate the route.

The deployed environment's public Ed25519 key and env_id must be pinned in .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml with added_at_log_position era anchor; live checks must confirm SigV4-signed round-trip success, unsigned rejection at API Gateway, and direct-origin rejection without the guard header.
